title: Keep sessions on removed or unconfigured remotes selectable in the Host filter
outcome: Users can choose a host still referenced by session data when its remote configuration is gone, and disabled choices are understandable.
acceptance: A session resolving to an unconfigured remote remains selectable by that host, or the UI applies a documented safe selection fallback when a selected host disappears.
Removing/changing remote configuration while its host is selected leaves a usable selection and clear label; existing sessions remain accessible.
